meta.title: Letter of Award
gaps: The prepared state provides only one line item and one invited bidder, so the case's exact allocation of all 10 units to Vendor B cannot be independently asserted beyond the allocation completing.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The prepared state provides only one line item and one invited bidder, so the case's exact allocation of all 10 units to Vendor B cannot be independently asserted beyond the allocation completing.

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on Master QCS.
Enter the awarding screen for the closed RFQ.
Allocate the available line item to Vendor B.
Verify the allocation selected the complete available line item and one vendor.
Create the award proposal after allocation.
Approve the submitted proposal as the buyer approver.
Open the proposal overview after approval.
Verify the overview shows the Letter of Award field.
Verify the overview shows the Letter of Award Status field.
Verify the overview identifies Vendor B.
